baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive construction joins طَعَامٌ to غِسْلِينٍ through مِنْ: the latter is the sole source or kind left under the category of food.
baseline_models.mechanism: What normally enters the body as tasted nourishment is sourced from a medium associated with washing outside the body. The verse therefore does more than substitute one dish for another; it forces an exterior cleansing category across the boundary into interior provision.

activation_trace.role: Tasting and taking food supplies the ordinary inward, hunger-answering side of the category that is being overturned.
Wash-water or a washing medium supplies the exterior substance that the exception makes function as inward food.

changed_reading.before: Ordinary food is denied and one repellent substitute is named.
changed_reading.after: Nourishment itself is category-inverted: the only inside provision comes from what belongs to an outside washing process.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: طَعَامٌ can carry provision and livelihood, while غِسْلِينٍ remains visibly attached to washing and removal.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sole livelihood is not something that adds strength but an operation whose basic action removes what adheres. Provision has become subtractive: instead of maintaining the recipient, it strips the recipient down.

activation_trace.role: Provision, livelihood, and good condition supply the sustaining function whose polarity is reversed.
Washing by flowing water removes adhered dirt, supplying subtraction as the only available mode of provision.

changed_reading.before: The condemned receive no sustaining ration.
changed_reading.after: They do receive a kind of provision, but its function is inverted from maintenance into removal and depletion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The food noun is paired exclusively with the unusual غِسْلِينٍ form, whose inventory retains an intense-heat candidate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The exception can preserve the sensory event of intake while canceling nourishment: what remains of food is only extreme thermal intensity. Eating supplies sensation without sustenance.

activation_trace.role: Taste and ingestion provide the sensory channel through which the exceptional substance is encountered.
The inventory's review-candidate sense of extreme heat supplies intensity while requiring explicit lexical caution.

changed_reading.before: غِسْلِينٍ names a noxious food substance.
changed_reading.after: The only residue of eating may be burning intensity itself: taste remains, but nourishment has been deleted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A branch of ط ع م names the throat as the place seized and squeezed, allowing the food noun to activate the bodily passage that food normally traverses.
baseline_models.mechanism: The nominal food can reverse eater and eaten. Instead of being taken through the throat, it becomes an attack at the throat, while the wash-medium supplies the material forced through that passage.

activation_trace.role: The throat-grip branch relocates food from nourishing object to an act of squeezing the route of ingestion.
The washing medium supplies what crosses the seized alimentary boundary.

changed_reading.before: The eater consumes an imposed food.
changed_reading.after: The imposed food takes the eater at the throat; ingestion becomes reversed agency rather than nourishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pleasant meal is tied to what was advanced, while the condemned person's stated failure concerns urging provision for another. The repeated food root turns the focus ration into a returned social account: provision withheld from circulation comes back as a washing operation that subtracts rather than sustains.

activation_trace.role: Food as livelihood or allotted provision lets the focus ration function as the settlement of an account.
Removal by washing gives the returned provision its subtractive rather than sustaining effect.
An advance payment supplies the ledger-like image by which an earlier act can mature into a later meal.
Urging toward an act identifies the omitted social motion, not merely a private failure to eat.
Feeding another and asking to be fed make food a reciprocal relation whose failed circulation returns in the focus.
Subsistence that enables a person to remain gives the withheld meal its life-stabilizing social function.

structural_cues: 69:24 links easy eating and drinking to what was sent ahead; 69:34-36 links failed urging to feed directly to the condemned person's sole food.
طَعَامِ at 69:34 and طَعَامٌ at 69:36 move the same root from another person's need to the subject's own ration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance, urging, other-directed feeding, subsistence, and wash-removal; I supply the reciprocal arrow from withheld circulation to returned ration. A live alternative is ethical contrast without a one-for-one account mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a punitive ration assigned after judgment.
changed_reading.after: The ration is an embodied account settlement: refused nourishment returns as provision whose only action is to strip nourishment away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, حَمِيمٌ denies an intimate companion, while its branch inventory also contains hot bathing water. The following wash-derived food can materialize that split: humane warmth disappears and only injurious thermal washing remains.

activation_trace.role: Wash-water gives material form to the thermal branch activated by the preceding companion noun.
The cautious intense-heat candidate sharpens the conversion of warmth into bodily harm.
Close kinship or intimacy supplies the human warmth explicitly absent immediately before the focus.
Hot water used for bathing supplies the same root's material pole, which the wash-derived food can continue.

structural_cues: The adjacent sequence is no حَمِيمٌ, then no food except from غِسْلِينٍ.
Both clauses are privative, but the second retains a harmful material remainder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root inventory spanning intimacy and hot bathing water, followed by a wash-derived focus noun; I infer a conversion from absent relational warmth to present harmful heat. The alternative is that the two branch domains merely coexist without an intended cross-activation.

changed_reading.before: The person separately lacks a friend and lacks ordinary food.
changed_reading.after: The sequence inverts care itself: human closeness is removed, while its heat returns impersonally as the washing medium forced into nourishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commands seize, collar, expose to fire, and insert the person. They activate the focus branch in which ط ع م reaches the throat as a squeezing grip: the carceral sequence does not stop outside the body but continues inward as the nominal meal.

activation_trace.role: The throat-seizure branch makes the food the internal continuation of bodily capture.
Intense heat links the ingested substance to the preceding exposure to fire, with the branch's review status kept visible.
Capture and arrest establish the reversal in which the person is taken rather than acting as taker.
A collar that binds an organ localizes external restraint at the neck and throat.
Encounter with fire supplies the thermal phase that the exceptional food carries inward.
Insertion of one thing into another supplies the directional movement from exterior confinement into an interior channel.

structural_cues: 69:30-32 is a serial imperative sequence of taking, binding, heating, and inserting before the focus names the sole food.
The later eating clause at 69:37 completes the same bodily route rather than opening a separate banquet scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external capture, a neck restraint, fire, insertion, and a focus branch naming throat seizure; I supply the arrow that treats them as one movement continuing into ingestion. They may alternatively be cumulative but independent punishments.

changed_reading.before: After external restraint, the prisoner is given a punitive meal.
changed_reading.after: The meal is restraint's internal phase: the eater does not master food; the food completes the seizure at the throat.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two adjacent exclusive constructions restrict first the food's source and then its eaters. The ration therefore acts as a sorting instrument: consuming it manifests membership in the class named by deliberate error and sin.

activation_trace.role: Actual tasting and intake make the focus category capable of marking its eater bodily.
The exclusive washing-source gives the marked class a correspondingly exclusive ration.
Literal eating supplies the act by which the preceding food restriction becomes embodied.
Sin and culpable error identify the eater class that the ration discloses.

structural_cues: 69:36 has no food except from one source; 69:37 has no eater of it except one class.
The repeated إِلَّا produces a source-to-consumer lock across the ayah boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored exclusions, ingestion, and the sinful eater class; I infer that the meal functions diagnostically as a verdict made bodily. The alternative is a narrower statement of dietary restriction with no sorting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies what the condemned must eat.
changed_reading.after: The exclusive food identifies who they are; eating is the enactment and disclosure of the verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, water exceeds its boundary while a flowing carrier bears life through it. In the focus, a wash-water category crosses the opposite boundary into the body and becomes sole food. The same material logic reverses from being carried safely over destructive water to carrying destructive water within.

activation_trace.role: Wash-water provides the fluid medium that is forced from an exterior domain into the alimentary interior.
Taking food inward supplies the reversed boundary crossing.
The non-dominant mapped inventory's overflowing water supplies destructive fluid that exceeds its proper limit.
Water delivered by pouring supplies directed fluid movement rather than a static substance.
Bearing an exposed load supplies the rescue relation that the focus materially reverses.
Flowing movement supplies the carrier's passage through the earlier water event.

structural_cues: 69:11 places excessive water outside a life-bearing vessel; 69:36 places a washing medium inside the eater.
Both scenes organize danger through fluid, containment, and passage across a boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflowing water, pouring, carrying, flowing, and wash-water made food; I supply the reversal from being carried across destructive water to carrying it inside. The alternative is recurrence of water imagery without a shared containment mechanism.

changed_reading.before: غِسْلِينٍ is simply the liquid-like substance available as food.
changed_reading.after: It is a boundary-reversed water event: the saved were once carried over destructive fluid, while this eater must carry destructive fluid within.

context_deltas.mechanism: Washing removes what adheres; the context stages public presentation where nothing hidden remains, then later activates covering and uncovering. The sole food can thus be carried as a forensic wash: an inward process that strips concealment and makes the eater's condition manifest.

activation_trace.role: Cleansing by removal supplies the stripping operation applied metaphorically to concealment.
Ingestion relocates the stripping operation inside the person rather than leaving it on an exterior surface.
Presenting something for inspection supplies the forensic scene in which the focus operation has an evidentiary result.
Removal of hiddenness supplies the reveal produced by the inferred washing operation.
Uncovering and removing a screen repeat the stripping side of washing later in the sequence.
Covering supplies the opposed condition that exposure and washing undo.

structural_cues: 69:18 explicitly pairs presentation with the negation of anything hidden.
69:50 places uncovering/regret beside a root whose branch field centers covering, creating a later removal-versus-covering hinge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies washing-removal, public display, removal of hiddenness, uncovering, and covering; I supply the arrow by which ingestion performs disclosure from within. A live alternative keeps physical punishment and epistemic exposure as separate mechanisms.

changed_reading.before: The exceptional food harms the body as a material punishment.
changed_reading.after: It also behaves like a forensic wash, stripping the eater's coverings from within so the embodied verdict cannot remain hidden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the animal-breeding branch of غ س ل with the fruit-ripening branch of ط ع م. It remains anchored in both focus roots and in the packet's explicit palm, hollow-interior, and harvest cues; downstream prose should label it a generativity analogy, not a lexical gloss of غِسْلِينٍ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sole food joins a food-root branch of ripening with a wash-root branch of repeated mating that produces no conception.

activation_trace.role: Fruit taking on flavor supplies maturation and yield as a latent function of food.
Repeated mating without impregnation supplies failed generation as the strange counter-function of the sole food.
The palm tree supplies the concrete fruit-bearing organism whose destroyed form precedes the focus.
A hollow belly supplies the bodily result of failed nourishment and failed continuation.
Harvest ripeness and its arrived time supply the fruitful counter-image that the focus anti-food reverses.

changed_reading.before: The sole ration is nutritionally empty or repellent.
changed_reading.after: It is an anti-harvest: activity repeats without ripening or offspring, leaving the interior hollow rather than continuing life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates the guest-provision branch from تَنزِيلٌ. It remains anchored in the focus food/provision root and the context's available ن ز ل inventory; render it only as an ironic hospitality model, not as the lexical meaning of تَنزِيلٌ in 69:43.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: طَعَامٌ can be provision or an allotted livelihood, while the sole available source is the washing medium.

activation_trace.role: Allotted provision allows the focus food to function as a reception ration rather than only a substance.
The wash-medium supplies the perversely unsuitable content of that ration.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest supplies the hospitality frame that the focus reverses into hostile reception.

changed_reading.before: The focus names a minimal survival ration in punishment.
changed_reading.after: The ration can be carried as hostile hospitality: an arrival is formally provisioned, but only with a medium that cannot perform care.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the intestinal-contraction image is a remote branch under ح ج ز while the surface at 69:47 concerns blockers. It remains anchored by the focus's wash-water-as-food and the explicit eat/drink counter-scene; downstream prose should call it a somatic echo, not a direct gloss of حَاجِزِينَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The only food is sourced from something water-like, inviting the question whether apparent fluid can relieve the eater at all.

activation_trace.role: Wash-water supplies a fluid appearance that might falsely suggest relief.
Ingestion routes that apparent fluid into the alimentary body.
Ordinary drinking supplies the relieving counter-function available in the positive meal.
Intake without hardship or harmful consequence supplies the condition denied by the focus.
Contraction of the intestines from thirst supplies the bodily barrier produced instead of fluid relief.

changed_reading.before: A wash-water-like ration is vile but at least materially fluid.
changed_reading.after: Its water-shape is anti-drink: rather than quenching, it closes the gut around thirst and turns fluid into obstruction.

strongest_changes: The repeated food root converts 69:36 into reciprocal settlement: other-directed feeding was withheld, so provision returns in subtractive form.
The adjacent حَمِيمٌ inventory lets absent human closeness invert into harmful bathing heat in the wash-derived food.
The capture, collar, fire, and insertion sequence reverses agency so the nominal food completes restraint at the throat.
The paired إِلَّا constructions make the ration not only punishment but a bodily sorting verdict.
summary.what_was_special: The focus couples an ordinary life-support noun with a wash-derived exception, then the context repeatedly activates boundary crossing: social provision returns as account, relational warmth becomes thermal harm, external restraint moves inward, and washing becomes disclosure. These mechanisms coexist rather than resolving to one gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The intense-heat branch for غ س ل is explicitly a review candidate, so every thermal model remains conditional.
The ح م م intimacy/hot-water conversion may be a productive adjacency effect rather than a deliberate lexical linkage.
The sterile harvest, hostile hospitality, and thirst-barrier readings are anchored but cross-domain; they should remain visibly exploratory.
